slides.texte_overlay:
how you make your brain
work better
Do one thing at a time. Multitasking feels productive, but it makes you slower and more tired. Close the tabs and focus on one task.
Take short breaks every hour. Five minutes of walking or stretching resets your attention and helps you think more clearly after. Your brain recovers fast.
Go outside in the morning light. Ten minutes of daylight wakes your body up and helps you feel alert for the rest of the day. Try it before noon.
Ask "why" three times. When you learn something, keep digging. Understanding the reasons behind facts makes them stick much longer.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A small daily dose of new knowledge keeps your mind active. Ask the next question.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A small daily dose of new knowledge keeps your mind active.

slides.texte_overlay: Move your body regularly. Exercise improves mood, sleep and focus. A thirty-minute workout is one of the best things for your thinking.
Protect your sleep. Your brain cleans and organises itself at night. Skipping sleep is like skipping the save button on everything you learned.
